items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: I played for her at the Dauphine Theater

ctx.x: And I worked, I worked, I played for her at the Dauphine Theater, and I forgot the name of the piano player. He was violin there for years, he was playing the show. So he sat out there and watched me, cause she was singing, instead of easy keys, instead of F, it'd be four sharps. Instead of being flat, it'd be five sharps. And I can, listen, I only had five lessons. I worked with Johnny Krueger at the, at the Colleton Sisters for eight months, and I was going crazy cause I'd take some of the heavy stuff. I, I…
Yeah. I couldn't take any lessons.
